items.summaryJa: シスコシステムズと米OpenAIが共同で開発したオープンソースプロジェクト「Shirudo」は、脆弱性が見つかってから恒久的なパッチ適用までの間、稼働中のLinuxシステムを再起動せずに防御することを目指す。中核にはカーネルを変更せず小規模なプログラムを実行できるeBPFとAIエージェントを活用し、安全性が確認された場合のみ一時的な防御策「Shield」を適用して攻撃を阻止する仕組みを検証する。Shirudoは「Java4shell」やPHPの脆弱性の検証で悪用の試みを検知・ブロックするコードを生成できたとしており、シスコはインフラ構築・保護の知見を、OpenAIはフロンティアAI研究と攻撃知見を提供する形で協働する。

items.summaryJa: ClaudeのMessages APIをPythonからRustへ移行し、サービスを止めずに並行開発を進めた結果、1リクエストあたりのCPU使用率を約70%削減し、最初のトークン生成時間を中央値で約20%短縮、1リクエストあたりのメモリ使用量を80%以上低減した。2023年に構築された同APIは研究用にPythonで実装されてきたが、2024年初頭から2026年秋にかけてトラフィックが約1,800倍に増加しており、パフォーマンス改善が急務だった。移行にはClaudeの協力を得て、新機能開発を止めずに作業を完了した。

items.title: Flags SDK now works on Vercel without FLAGS_SECRET
items.summary: With flags@4.5.0 , projects on Vercel can use Flags Explorer and precompute without FLAGS_SECRET . That cuts out a setup step for new projects and removes the need to keep a shared secret in sync across microfrontends. Vercel signs Flags Explorer discovery requests and overrides, and the SDK encrypts flag values shown in the Vercel Toolbar with Vercel’s public key. Existing projects keep using FLAGS_SECRET while the environment variable is set or the secret is passed in code. Upgrading alone doesn't switch them to Vercel-managed keys. To use Vercel-managed keys for these features, remove the environment variable and any code that passes the secret explicitly. For local development, run vercel env pull . Precomputed codes created without a secret work only in the deployment that created them. Precompute without a secret requires Vercel system environment variables, which are enabled by default. Prebuilt deployments and codes that must work across deployments still need a secret; use FLAGS_PRECOMPUTE_SECRET if only precompute needs one. If you use a build cache, see the precompute documentation for the required configuration. Learn more in the Flags SDK documentation . Read more

Inkling 2 Mini has 26.4 billion total parameters and 3.4 billion active per token. The model runs its middle layers more than once for every token, which lets it reason further before writing anything down and often reach an answer with fewer reasoning tokens. Like Inkling 2 Small, it is strongest on long-running agentic tasks. The model has a 1M-token context window, and reasoning effort can be set from none through max . Use thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini as the model name: To use it in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more, install the latest Vercel CLI and run setup: Then select thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini in the agent. See the coding agents guide for details. Try Inkling 2 Mini in the model playground . AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime. It includes built-in custom reporting , Zero Data Retention support , budgets for API keys , routing rules , and more. AI Gateway reflects provider pricing with no markup and does not charge a platform fee on inference, including on Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) requests.
